environment: Production build with disposable local Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL and native browser navigation
scope: G03 local sign-in, sign-out, protected deep links and same-origin email confirmation
limits: Native navigation is qualified on IPv4 loopback, with built HTTP checks on IPv4 and localhost and IPv6 route/unit coverage. Email proof guards include expired-code refusal; this checkpoint adds no native password change, colleague invitation acceptance or Google OAuth acceptance. Remaining G01/G03 journeys, wider failure states and operational gates stay open. Local captured mail is separate from external email delivery; service evidence retains its prior pin.
